verdict.rationale: Kit exposes a substantial V4 API and MCP server covering broadcasts, subscribers, tags/segments, custom fields, webhooks, OAuth and bulk operations, and even lets AI agents perform natural-language account actions (kit-docs-1,5,20,29,36-39). However, many UI-advertised features—Visual Automations, landing pages/forms builder, A/B testing, collaborative editing, digital product sales—have no documented API endpoints, and no OpenAPI spec could be found (kit-probe-2), suggesting incomplete API parity with the UI. Missing for 10: API endpoints/docs for automations builder, landing page/form design, digital commerce, and A/B testing; a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable full surface.
